hunks.baseline: All the more so when it was a permanent farewell caused by the death of someone close.
hunks.sol: All the more so when death made the parting with someone close permanent.

hunks.baseline: But I had never wanted to reunite like this.
hunks.sol: But no one could have wanted a reunion like this.

hunks.baseline: “……Pai Chen?”
hunks.sol: “…Pai Chen?”

hunks.baseline: A name slipped out like a groan.
hunks.sol: The name came out like a groan.

hunks.baseline: And a face so familiar I could recognize it at a glance from far away, yet more unfamiliar than ever.
hunks.sol: Even from a distance, the face was instantly recognizable. And yet it had never looked so unfamiliar.

hunks.baseline: Faces.
hunks.sol: The faces.

hunks.baseline: “Long ago, there were some especially exceptional beings in the world where I lived. The ones called warriors or heroes.”
hunks.sol: “Long ago, in the world where I lived, there were some exceptionally gifted beings. They were called warriors or heroes.”

hunks.baseline: The wicked Dragon’s voice, steeped in old memories, reached Jin Taekyung’s ears as he stood frozen like a statue.
hunks.sol: The wicked Dragon’s voice, steeped in old memories, reached Jin Taekyung as he stood frozen like a statue.

hunks.baseline: “At first, they were a nuisance. I didn’t much care for them coming all the way to my lair to cause trouble over some trivial matter.”
hunks.sol: “At first, they were a nuisance. I didn’t much care for them coming all the way to my lair and behaving rudely over some trivial matter.”

hunks.baseline: Morgoth could never quite understand their behavior.
hunks.sol: Morgoth had never quite understood them.

hunks.baseline: All he had done was burn a few cities and wipe out a kingdom, and they came all the way to his lair to make a scene.
hunks.sol: All he’d done was burn a few cities and wipe out a kingdom. Why come all the way to his lair to make a scene?

hunks.baseline: “At least, not until I met one human.”
hunks.sol: “At least, that was how I felt until I met one human.”

hunks.baseline: He was exceptional, even among the hundreds of heroes who had come before him.
hunks.sol: He had stood out even among the hundreds of heroes who had come before him.

hunks.baseline: Strong, tough, and more desperate in battle than anyone.
hunks.sol: He was strong, resilient, and fought more desperately than anyone.

hunks.baseline: Perhaps that was why.
When he died, leaving behind nothing but a pool of blood—not even a proper corpse, just like all the other intruders—Morgoth felt regret for the first time.
hunks.sol: Perhaps that was why, when the man died without leaving so much as a proper corpse—reduced to a little pool of blood like all the other intruders—Morgoth felt regret for the first time.

hunks.baseline: And, deep in his heart, a powerful desire to possess him rose with it.
hunks.sol: Along with it came a powerful desire to possess him, rising from deep within.

hunks.baseline: “That was when I began to collect ‘trophies’ in earnest.”
hunks.sol: “That was when I began collecting ‘trophies’ in earnest.”

hunks.baseline: Not mere cold, hard gold and jewels, but special trophies that retained their own memories and light.
hunks.sol: Not mere cold, hard gold and jewels, but special trophies, each retaining its own memories and light.

hunks.baseline: If they could be made to submit, he made them submit. If they refused every offer, he killed them just to keep them by his side.
hunks.sol: Those he could force to submit, he did. Those who refused every offer, he killed so he could keep them by his side anyway.

hunks.baseline: His most precious trophies, under the name of Guardians.
hunks.sol: His most precious trophies, given the name Guardians.

hunks.baseline: And this fascinating collection had continued in an unfamiliar world called Earth.
hunks.sol: And he had continued this fascinating collection in the unfamiliar world called Earth.

hunks.baseline: “They’re still unfinished, but the material is good, so the results are excellent.”
hunks.sol: “They’re still unfinished, but the material is good. The results are excellent.”

hunks.baseline: Jin Taekyung didn’t answer the question, which was brimming with satisfaction.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung didn’t answer the question, so plainly asked with satisfaction.

hunks.baseline: No—he couldn’t. All he could do was stare at the faces, pale and bloodless, now standing at the head of the Dragon-tooth soldiers, and mutter their names to himself.
hunks.sol: He couldn’t. All he could do was look at the bloodless faces now standing at the head of the Dragon-tooth soldiers and recite their names to himself.

hunks.baseline: *Pai Chen, Joel Schumacher, Pablo Albatroses……*
hunks.sol: *Pai Chen, Joel Schumacher, Pablo Albatroses…*

hunks.baseline: Heroes who represented their countries, comrades reliable enough to entrust with one another’s backs.
hunks.sol: Heroes who had represented their countries. Comrades who had trusted one another to watch their backs.

hunks.baseline: During the Black Dragon’s great invasion over the past several days, they had been reported to have perished gloriously, their bodies never even found.
hunks.sol: Over the past several days of the Black Dragon’s great invasion, they had been reported killed in battle, their bodies never found.

hunks.baseline: And now they stood here.
hunks.sol: Now they stood here.

hunks.baseline: Unable to rest even in death.
hunks.sol: Denied rest even in death.

hunks.baseline: Reduced to puppets whose very souls had been stolen.
hunks.sol: Puppets robbed of their very souls.

hunks.baseline: They raised keen-edged swords, maces, halberds, and shields. They drew their bows.
hunks.sol: They raised sharp swords, maces, halberds, and shields. They drew their bows.

hunks.baseline: Not at anyone else, but at Jin Taekyung.
hunks.sol: At Jin Taekyung, of all people.

hunks.baseline: The one who had been their only beacon in the darkness, lighting the way before them all—their hope.
hunks.sol: At the one light that had shown them the way when they could see nothing in the darkness. Their hope.

hunks.baseline: The murderous intent of the monsters, now surrounding them on every side without a gap, surged like blades. Beyond the thousand Dragon-tooth soldiers, forming one enormous wall before their master, the wicked Dragon smiled white as snow.
hunks.sol: The monsters had surrounded him on every side. Their murderous intent whipped around him like blades. Beyond the thousand Dragon-tooth soldiers forming an immense wall before their master, the wicked Dragon smiled, his teeth gleaming white.

hunks.baseline: And that one line was the signal that announced the start of everything.
hunks.sol: Those words were the signal.

hunks.baseline: A wave of monsters poured down without end, shaking heaven and earth.
hunks.sol: A wave of monsters poured in without end, shaking heaven and earth.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, Jin Taekyung, who had stood frozen in the cold, half-opened his eyes.
hunks.sol: At the same time, Jin Taekyung’s frozen expression shifted. His eyes narrowed to half-lidded slits.

hunks.baseline: Blue-black flames burst out, coiling around his spearhead and flooding the whole area with blinding light.
hunks.sol: Blue-black flames burst forth, coiling around his spearhead and flooding the whole area with blinding light.

hunks.baseline: The chimes ringing incessantly in his ears seemed to grow more distant. The stench and roars pouring from the monsters had never been closer or clearer.
hunks.sol: The chimes ringing incessantly in his ears seemed to grow more distant. The monsters’ stench and roars had never felt closer or clearer.

hunks.baseline: The Cyclops, a one-eyed giant as tall as a walking skyscraper, slammed both fists down with a roar that shook heaven and earth.
hunks.sol: A Cyclops—a one-eyed giant as tall as a walking skyscraper—slammed both fists down with a roar that shook heaven and earth.

hunks.baseline: Compressed air exploded. The mountain of force behind its fists crushed and burst everything it touched.
hunks.sol: Compressed air exploded. The mountain of force behind its fists crushed and burst everything they touched.

hunks.baseline: Everything except the one person it absolutely had to bring down.
hunks.sol: Everything except the one person it had to bring down.

hunks.baseline: By the time the giant finally spotted that human, smaller than its palm, a spearhead wreathed in blue-black flames was already boring into its single eye.
hunks.sol: By the time the giant spotted the human, smaller than its palm, a spearhead wreathed in blue-black flames was already driving into its single eye.

hunks.baseline: The spear pierced its eye as smoothly as if slicing through tofu. At the same time, the dreadful heat flowing through the spearhead melted the giant’s brain and sent its massive body crashing down.
hunks.sol: The spear pierced the eye as easily as a knife through tofu. The terrible heat carried through its tip melted the giant’s brain, and its massive body toppled.

hunks.baseline: Monsters caught beneath the dying giant screamed. Those who lost sight of their target in the momentary dust hesitated.
hunks.sol: Monsters caught beneath the dead giant screamed. Others lost sight of their target in the dust and hesitated.

hunks.baseline: Not realizing that this was the last mistake they would ever make.
hunks.sol: They had no idea it was the last mistake they would ever make.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, a spear shot through the air like a ray of light, sweeping through the Liches commanding the monster army that had survived the massive explosion.
hunks.sol: A spear shot through the air like a ray of light, sweeping through the Liches commanding the monster army that had survived the enormous explosion.

hunks.baseline: Dozens of layers of defensive spells were useless. So were Blink spells cast in the blink of an eye.
hunks.sol: Dozens of layered defensive spells were useless. So were Blink spells cast in the blink of an eye.

hunks.baseline: More precisely, the unprecedented force carried by the spearhead made them all meaningless.
hunks.sol: The unprecedented force behind the spearhead rendered them all meaningless.

hunks.baseline: A power and speed so astonishing that even “overwhelming” fell short.
hunks.sol: Its power and speed were so astonishing that even *overwhelming* fell short.

hunks.baseline: Watching Jin Taekyung dominate the battlefield like the hero of an ancient myth, Morgoth was genuinely impressed.
hunks.sol: Morgoth was genuinely impressed as he watched Jin Taekyung dominate the battlefield like the hero of an ancient myth.

hunks.baseline: He had personally seen and fought countless powerful beings over the past several thousand years.
hunks.sol: He had seen and fought countless powerful beings over the past several thousand years.

hunks.baseline: But neither an elven Elder who had lived nearly a thousand years, nor a Dwarf king blessed by the rocky mountains, nor the human knight called the greatest on the continent had ever displayed such martial prowess.
hunks.sol: Yet neither an elven Elder who had lived nearly a thousand years, nor a dwarf king blessed by the rocky mountains, nor the human knight called the greatest on the continent had displayed martial prowess like this.

hunks.baseline: No. They had been nowhere close.
hunks.sol: No. None of them had come close.

hunks.baseline: The humans in this unfamiliar world were strong.
hunks.sol: The humans of this unfamiliar world were strong.

hunks.baseline: They grew stronger through some mysterious power Morgoth couldn’t begin to understand. And a tiny handful of those humans, chosen from among the rest, became superhumans who far surpassed their given limits.
hunks.sol: They grew stronger through a mysterious power even Morgoth couldn’t fathom. And a tiny chosen few surpassed their given limits by so much that they became superhumans.

hunks.baseline: Like Cheon Taemin, who was as good as dead now.
hunks.sol: Like Cheon Taemin, who was said to be as good as dead now.

hunks.baseline: Or the young hero of the human race, recklessly brave as he was.
hunks.sol: Or that recklessly brave young human hero.

hunks.baseline: Even if he had to set aside his pride.
hunks.sol: Even if it meant setting aside his pride.

hunks.baseline: A short Spell, yet one imbued with powerful Magic no other race could match, rang across the battlefield.
hunks.sol: The short spell rang across the battlefield, charged with magical power no other race could match.

hunks.baseline: An extreme cold that froze everything spread across hundreds of meters.
hunks.sol: Cold fierce enough to freeze everything swept across hundreds of meters.

hunks.baseline: At its far end stood a human who had reduced the endless flood of high-level monsters to a mere flock of sheep.
hunks.sol: At its far end stood the human who had reduced the endless flood of high-level monsters to a mere flock of sheep.

hunks.baseline: An ice wall erupted around him, several meters thick and ten times as tall, enclosing him on every side. It was closer to a prison.
hunks.sol: Ice walls several meters thick and ten times as tall erupted around Jin Taekyung, enclosing him on every side. They were less a barrier than a prison.

hunks.baseline: A prison built solely to hold Jin Taekyung—and a coffin prepared for his death.
hunks.sol: A prison built solely to hold him—and a coffin prepared for his death.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, a sphere of flame emerged from between the dark clouds.
An unbearable heat, so vast no Grand Mage in any world had ever imagined it, crashed down upon the ice wall.
hunks.sol: A sphere of flame emerged from between the dark clouds, enormous beyond anything a Grand Mage of any world could have imagined. Its terrible heat crashed down upon the ice walls.

hunks.baseline: A blinding flash, fierce enough to make your eyes go blind just by facing it.
hunks.sol: The flash was fierce enough to blind anyone who faced it.

hunks.baseline: The flames, worthy of being called the fires of Hell itself, melted the ice wall and burned everything trapped inside.
hunks.sol: The flames, worthy of being called the fires of Hell itself, melted the ice and burned everything trapped inside.

hunks.baseline: The thousand monsters thrown away as bait—and one human who hadn’t managed to escape the spell’s range in time.
hunks.sol: The thousand monsters thrown in as bait—and the human they had kept from escaping the spell’s range in time.

hunks.baseline: A tiny tremor began among the monsters’ corpses, now reduced to piles of charcoal.
hunks.sol: A faint movement stirred among the monsters’ charred corpses.

hunks.baseline: When a familiar face emerged from the gaps, Morgoth quietly licked his lips.
hunks.sol: A familiar face emerged from between them. Morgoth licked his lips.

hunks.baseline: That hadn’t been ordinary Hell Fire.
hunks.sol: It hadn’t been ordinary Hell Fire.

hunks.baseline: He had used his knowledge to maximize its power and limits, and he had even put his full strength behind the attack.
hunks.sol: He had used his own knowledge to push its power and limits to the utmost, then put his full strength behind it.

hunks.baseline: A direct hit would have left even another Dragon with a potentially fatal wound.
hunks.sol: A direct hit would have left even a fellow Dragon gravely wounded.

hunks.baseline: And Jin Taekyung had withstood all that heat, without even being able to dodge.
hunks.sol: Yet Jin Taekyung had endured all that heat with no way to dodge.

hunks.baseline: Morgoth muttered in a low voice.
hunks.sol: Morgoth muttered, his voice low.

hunks.baseline: “This is…… a little troublesome.”
hunks.sol: “This is… a little troublesome.”

hunks.baseline: No, perhaps more than that.
hunks.sol: Perhaps more than a little.

hunks.baseline: An unpredictable danger always lurked behind a situation that exceeded expectations.
hunks.sol: Whenever events exceeded his expectations, some unknown danger lurked behind them.

hunks.baseline: And this danger was bigger and faster than Morgoth had thought.
hunks.sol: And this danger was greater—and faster—than he had thought.

hunks.sol: An explosion burst from beneath Jin Taekyung’s feet with a thunderous roar.

hunks.sol: True to the meaning of Flamefire Path’s name, he surged forward, carving a path of blue-black flames.

hunks.baseline: *Slice, rumble!*
hunks.sol: *Slice—CRUNCH!*

hunks.baseline: Everything blocking his way was split apart and broken.
hunks.sol: Everything in his way split and shattered.

hunks.baseline: If the monster army flooding in from every direction was a wave, he was a single spearhead piercing through it.
hunks.sol: If the monster army flooding in from every direction was a wave, he was a spearhead piercing through it.

hunks.sol: And then, in the eyes of the monsters falling and spraying green blood, Jin Taekyung saw something familiar.

hunks.sol: His weary steps carried him through pools of blood.
